reuse_rule: Each certificate requires exact saved full_qpos, exact original source STL SHA256 and matching pure-FK transforms for both bodies. Source triangles are unchanged by the new collision proxy.
source_geometry_limit: Positive continuous source-surface distance does not establish disjoint physical solids when source mesh topology is non-watertight; no trajectory-wide claims follow from 3 targeted frames.
